en.name: Bravery and Resolve Circuit
en.effect:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per turn.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Trickstar Fusion" to your Deck, and 1 "Trickstar Band Sweet Guitar" and 1 "Trickstar Divaridis" to your Extra Deck, all from outside your Deck.
2: If you have "Trickstar Divaridis" on your field, add 1 "Trickstar Fusion" from your Deck to your hand.

releases.description: Summon "Trickstar Holly Angel" 3 time(s) while playing as Blue Gal.
